Name: Sabrine's Cottage
Author: Emirae
Description:
Alternate textures for each house upgrade: This mod provides new textures for each stage of farmhouse upgrades, including the basic wooden house, the stone house, the hardwood house, and the final deluxe house.

Easy to use: Installing and using this mod is simple and hassle-free. Just download and install the mod, and you're ready to go!

Note: Please be aware that due to the nature of the mod, you will need to reapply the textures after every house upgrade. This can be done by applying the changes again with your paint bucket. It is recommended to back up your game files before using this mod to avoid any potential issues.




Credits:
This mod was created by Yri and Hecate. Special thanks to the East Scarp Discord Community and Stardew Valley modding community for their support and inspiration. Also a thank you for FrenchDodo for showing me how to make it into an Alternative Texture!



Extra Notes: Spouse is Jio available from Ridgeside Village. Recolor is Earthy. Grass is Clover.
